title: audio.invoke — Input Schema (v1)
description: Provider-neutral MCP tool for governed audio analysis. One entry point for transcription, classification, diarization, acoustic event detection, and structured audio reasoning across the arifOS federation.

artifact_refs.description: One or more audio/voice/video artifacts to analyse. Each entry carries an expected MIME type and a content-addressable reference.

uri.description: Content-addressable or signed URI for the artifact (file://, data:, signed https://, or local /root/... path for trusted agents).

expected_mime_type.description: Expected MIME type for the artifact. Video types are accepted; the audio track will be extracted for analysis.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 hex digest for integrity verification before processing.

time_range.description: Process only this time window of the artifact.

end_ms.description: End offset in milliseconds (exclusive). Must be >= start_ms.

oneOf.description: 'all' — keep discrete channels; 'mono_mix' — downmix to mono.
Zero-based channel indices to keep (e.g., [0] = left only).

task.description: Primary analysis task for the audio artifact(s).

language_hint.description: Hint for ASR language detection (BCP 47 tag, e.g., 'ms-MY', 'en-US', 'zh-CN'). Provider uses this as a preference, not a hard constraint.

target_language.description: Target language for translation tasks (BCP 47 tag). Required when task='translate'.

output_mode.description: Controls the verbosity and shape of the output. 'full' returns all fields; 'summary' collapses transcript to a paragraph; 'segments_only' returns only transcript/diarization arrays; 'structured_only' returns structured_data + provenance without natural-language answer.

risk_tier.description: Constitutional risk classification. 'critical' forces human_review_required=true regardless of confidence. Governs provider selection and policy checks.

max_cost_usd.description: Maximum acceptable cost in USD for this request. If routing would exceed this, return a budget_exceeded error.

max_latency_ms.description: Maximum acceptable end-to-end latency. Providers that cannot meet this are skipped.

external_provider.description: Force a specific provider (e.g., 'dashscope/qwen-audio-3.0-asr-flash', 'local/faster-whisper'). If unavailable, return provider_unavailable. Omit for automatic routing via federation SOT.

retain_transcript.description: If true, the raw transcript is persisted to the federation audit log. Default false (transcript is ephemeral, only the answer/observations persist).

redact_sensitive.description: If true, PII, credentials, and financial identifiers detected in the transcript are redacted before inclusion in the output.

trace_id.description: Optional 128-bit trace ID (32 hex chars) for cross-request correlation. If omitted, the server generates one.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs, resolve routing, and return estimated cost/latency without processing the artifact. No provider calls are made.
